evidence: The ALD of nickel was performed on a silicon oxide (SiO2) layer thermally grown on (100) silicon at 1100 °C. The sublimation hot source was used at 180 − 200 °C for nickel acetylacetonate, while the alcohols were evaporated at room temperature. One ALD cycle comprised alternate pulses of Ni(acac) (pulse time tNi) and the alcohol (pulse time tAlcohol), separated by a reactor purge time (tP). The purge time was fixed at 2 s, while the pulse times of Ni(acac)2 and alcohol were varied from 0.1 s to 4 s. The growth temperature was investigated from 250 to 300 °C.
